from atomate2.abinit.powerups import update_factory_kwargs
from atomate2.cli.dev import save_abinit_maker
from atomate2.abinit.jobs.core import RelaxMaker


# The following lines define the maker.
# Adapt for specific job/flow maker test.
maker = RelaxMaker()
maker = update_factory_kwargs(maker, dict(kppa=10, ecut=4.0, nband=4, spin_mode="unpolarized"))

# Save the maker and metadata to maker.json
save_abinit_maker(maker)
